visual_elements.description: Truth table with red borders. 3 columns, 5 rows (1 header + 4 data rows). Headers: X₁, X₂, O/P. Row 1: 0, 0, 0 (cyan cells). Row 2: 0, 1, 0 (cyan cells). Row 3: 1, 0, 0 (cyan cells). Row 4: 1, 1, 1 (green cells).

2D Cartesian plot. Vertical axis with arrow up, tick label '2' at the y=2 level. Horizontal axis with arrow right, label 'x₁'. Dark blue descending line (decision boundary) running from (0,2) on the vertical axis to (1.2,0) on the horizontal axis, per the equation intercepts. Three cyan circular points: one near origin (0,0), one on y-axis at y=2, one on x-axis near x=1. One green circular point above the line near x=1, y=1. Numeric label '1.2' in red adjacent to the x-axis. Red border around plot area.

Perceptron/neural network diagram. Inputs on left: x₁ with weight -5, x₂ with weight -3, bias 1 with weight 6 (red text). Arrows converge to circle containing Σ (summation). Arrow to rectangular step function with text '>0 => 1' and '<0 => 0'. Arrow to output labeled 'O/P'. Red border around diagram.
Rounded rectangle box with light orange/peach fill and red border containing the equation text.
